request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: Change only his skin colour: the face, both ears, the hands and the feet become a much brighter, lighter yellow-olive green with a darker olive shadow tone, so the face is clearly visible under the helmet. Keep everything else exactly the same: the rusted iron pot helmet and goggles, the dark leather clothes, the bomb with its yellow stripes and spark, the satchel, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
